about: Documents and the verdicts of the generated schemas, held by both validators (kits/go/configschema, kits/rust/sluis-schema) to the same result and the same words (REQ-DATA-038, REQ-DATA-044, REQ-OPS-002). Each case applies its ops to `base` and names the first failure by path and rule, or null for a document the schema accepts. A case that is valid under the schema may still be refused by the loader: the schema states the form, and protovalidate rules and the loader state the rest (ADR 0004).

cases.name: the local example, as the base
duration 0s passes the pattern; the range is a protovalidate rule that the loader applies
cases.note: the schema states the form only (ADR 0004): a zero duration is refused by the loader, not by the schema
